nodes.description: Autophagic lysosome reformation recycles autolysosome membranes into new lysosomes through tubules that bud and undergo scission. In INPP5K-deficient myoblasts the autolysosomes enlarge and hyperextended reformation tubules persist, with the PI(4,5)P2 effector clathrin failing to disengage, so new lysosomes are not released. Wild-type INPP5K, but not disease mutants, restores lysosome homeostasis, which ties the patient alleles to this step.
